scope.name: Three additional Coin Champ mini games and shared recovery/input paths

features.name: New game room and complete mini games

limitations: No publication, provider changes or Supabase/RLS verification.
Local engine and viewport/touch emulation are not physical Android/iPhone/iPad acceptance.
Real audio, safe areas, zoom, installed Capacitor and hardware performance remain unverified.
One active session per browser profile; no cloud or independent per-mode saves.
Renderer target introspection was an isolated diagnostic, separate from the normal customer journey tests.

test_identity_refs: Disposable local browser guest contexts and same-origin iframe fixture
